question: England lift the ICC Men's T20 World Cup 2022 trophy after beating ______.
solution:
The correct answer is __**Pakistan.**__ [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• England **defeated Pakistan** in the final match of the **ICC Men's T20 World Cup 2022.**
 
• This was **England's 2ⁿd victory** in the T20 World Cup.
 
• The match was played at the Melbourne Cricket Ground, Australia.
 
• England's victory was led by their captain** Jos Buttler****, **who played a crucial role in the final match.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **New Zealand** has **never** won the T20 World Cup.
 
• Their best performance in the tournament was reaching the final in 2009 and 2021.
 
• **India** has won the T20 World Cup** **once, in **2007.**
 
• They were also the** runners-up in the 2014** edition of the tournament.
 
• The **ICC Men's T20 World Cup** is a **biennial international cricket championship** organized by the **International Cricket Council (ICC).**
 
• The tournament features teams from around the world competing in the shortest format of the game - **T20 (Twenty20).**
